name: Riceberg Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Riceberg Ventures (riceberg.vc; site title 'riceberg'), a global pre-seed and seed deep-tech VC founded in 2023 by Ankit Anand, Lino Gandola, Mredul Sarda and Shubham Raj. The site's team page lists the same four as Managing and General Partners. SEC Form Ds for Riceberg Ventures Premier Fund I, LP (Delaware; principal place of business Adliswil, Switzerland) name the same four as managing partners of the manager, Riceberg Ventures, LLC. The firm co-founded the KickSky Space Labs accelerator with E2MC Ventures and Aniara, which is a separate entity. Riceberg is not Iceberg Ventures and not any Rice University venture fund. The 'Riceberg-IN-1015 Fund I, a series of AngelList Funds 2024, LP' in EDGAR names no Riceberg person, so its link to the firm is unconfirmed. ricebergtestdemo.pages.dev, which appeared in search results, is a test mirror and was not used.

thesis_text.value: Global pre-seed and seed deep-tech fund that backs research-heavy, mission-driven founders turning scientific breakthroughs into industry products. Invests across spacetech, medtech/life sciences, cleantech and energy, cybersecurity, future of compute (silicon, quantum) and foundational AI and robotics, including physical AI for manufacturing. Writes $100K-$500K cheques, mostly as a co-investor, and is especially keen on Indian-origin founders worldwide.

open_items: Unverified leads: no fetched page confirms Riceberg attending One Way Summit SF (Oct 28-29 2026). The 'industrial / hard tech / physical AI' category fits only partly. The firm lists Foundational AI & Robotics and talks about physical AI for manufacturing (Hindu BusinessLine), and Lino Gandola names industrial robotics as the next inflection (Analytics Insight). No industrial-manufacturing portfolio company was found.

Round sourcing is thin. Only 3 of 9 rounds (EtherealX Series A, AkashaLabdhi pre-seed, Manastu pre-Series A) come from press or the firm's own pages naming Riceberg. Dirac Labs, Rigor AI, Cligent Aerospace, Sleepiz and Signatur come from database pages only (CB Insights, Caplight, Preqin), so their confidence is low. Arch0's pre-seed is described by Inc42, which does not name Riceberg; only CB Insights lists Riceberg in that round.
WebSearch budget ran out mid-research, so more rounds may exist. CB Insights counts 15 Riceberg investments and hides a 2025-08-05 pre-seed and a 2025-07-01 seed behind a paywall.

Portfolio companies where no round naming Riceberg was found: AMI Labs (its $1.03B round, March 2026, lists co-leads and backers without Riceberg); Cellbricks (€10M, March 2026; F4 says Riceberg participated, but the company release names only Silicon Roundabout, SPRIND, ACT and 'long-term investors', and GlobeNewswire returned 403); Swisspod (newsroom releases do not name Riceberg); Keyron Medical (investors page omits Riceberg; CB Insights lists Riceberg with no round); Surf Therapeutics (Riceberg logo on its site; the Business Wire release of 2026-03-17 on financing bringing total funding to $6M returned 403); BChar, CPTI and the stealth fusion company (nothing found). EtherealX's August 2024 $5M seed, led by YourNest, does not name Riceberg, although Riceberg listed EtherealX as a portfolio company in January 2025.

Skylark Labs: Venture Intelligence (citing Mint, July 2026) names Riceberg among expected participants in a $100-150M round that is still in talks at a valuation above $1B. Not recorded because no close is reported. Skylark's $6M round in April 2026 was not found naming Riceberg.
AnduraX (KickSky cohort-2 graduate, featured on Riceberg's site) raised institutional funding according to Business Standard, but no page found names Riceberg as an investor.

Funds: the close date and final size of the $20M debut fund are unknown, and so is its relationship to Riceberg Ventures Premier Fund I, LP. Premier Fund I was still raising at the last Form D/A (2026-01-05: $3.38M sold against a $5M offering, 55 investors, offering expected to last more than one year), so its size is the amount sold, not a final size. The SPV close dates are the Form D filing dates of fully sold offerings, and the portfolio companies they back are not stated. 'Riceberg-IN-1015 Fund I, a series of AngelList Funds 2024, LP' ($197,000 sold, first sale 2025-09-04) names only AngelList entities, so it was not attributed to the firm. CB Insights lists a 'Riceberg Ventures Fund I' with no size or date.
leads=false rests on F4's database inference ('participant rather than a lead') and on the rounds observed. The firm does not say whether it leads rounds.

requires_us_entity='no' is inferred, not stated: Riceberg invested directly in Indian companies (EtherealX share allotment per Entrackr's review of filings; Manastu; AkashaLabdhi) and backs companies in Switzerland, the UK, Germany and France. No stated policy was found.

Partners: the team page has no bios. Focus sectors come from interviews (Gandola: Analytics Insight; Sarda: Hindu BusinessLine; Anand: spacetech, KickSky and AnduraX coverage). Shubham Raj's focus was not found. The venture partners (Prof Uday Desai, Prasad Chaganti, Gaurav Lakhwani, Shrikant Sathe) were not recorded because no industrial, AI or hardware focus was found for them.

Company details not found: AkashaLabdhi website; founding years for AkashaLabdhi, Manastu Space, Dirac Labs, Rigor AI and Sleepiz; amounts for the Cligent, Rigor AI, Sleepiz and Signatur rounds. Rigor AI's website is the domain CB Insights shows; Riceberg's portfolio links only its LinkedIn page.
